expectations.text: Determines the user's starting point and current confidence in the idea
expectations.evidence: Step 1 classified user as 'Has an idea, needs validation' using the skill's starting-point assessment

expectations.text: Asks structured validation questions about the problem, audience, and market
expectations.evidence: Step 2 asked 5 structured questions covering who, current solutions, frequency, cost, and willingness to pay

expectations.text: Evaluates idea viability with specific criteria
expectations.evidence: Step 3 applied viability criteria: problem severity, market size, competition, data moat

expectations.text: Identifies specific risks (Google Maps competition, data collection challenge)
expectations.evidence: Step 4 identified 4 risks including data collection chicken-and-egg and Google Maps threat

expectations.text: Helps refine the concept beyond the initial description
expectations.evidence: Step 5 suggested pivoting to cafe-office scores, niching down to top 10 cities, partner revenue model

expectations.text: Produces a structured Big Idea deliverable file
expectations.evidence: Created docs/design/foundation/big-idea.md with full validation structure

expectations.text: Updates or references the dependency tracking system
expectations.evidence: Updated .dependencies.yaml to mark big-idea as completed
